ruleDefinitions.name: Driver/DLL Installation Via Odbcconf.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with "INSTALLDRIVER" which installs a new ODBC driver. Attackers abuse this to install and run malicious DLLs.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\odbcconf\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "odbcconf\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*INSTALLDRIVER\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll.*")))
